intent: Edit nine actual mis-capitalized drafts with case-sensitive checks; distinguish a named place from an ordinary description and May from modal may; independently correct a fresh sentence.
picturePurpose: The same original travel scene supports changing learner-written captions for a person, named attraction and ordinary wall. Written cards supply names and facts; code supplies exact text.

transfer.stem:
替同学校对一条新的学习记录。只改大小写，保留所有词、词序和标点，写出完整句子。
my friend ben studies french in june.

accepted: My friend Ben studies French in June.
answer.display: My friend Ben studies French in June.

explanation.strategy: 先找句首，再按词在这里表达的意思检查人名、语言和月份。

steps.text: 句首 my 改为 My，人名 ben 改为 Ben。
steps.reason: 句子开头与人名的首字母都要大写。

steps.text: french 改为 French，june 改为 June；friend、studies、in 保持小写。
steps.reason: 语言名和月份名首字母大写，普通名词和动词不因重要就大写。

explanation.pitfall: 不要把每个词都大写，也不要漏掉句中人名、语言和月份的首字母。

visual.title: 按作用逐处校对
visual.caption: 其余词和句号保留；这是校对，不是改写。

explanation.transfer: 如果把月份换成 July，哪些部分仍需大写？
